book.name: Yohana
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala YOHANA

content: À bwal Yesu
Anzǝm mǝnana Yesu malǝna hiwi ka, pǝlǝa lo andǝ alaggana male à eauwe a nkaring mala ɓangŋaban Kidǝron. À kya kutio a ɓè ɓaban mala anggun olif.
Yahuda, mǝnana mak Yesu ka, súrǝ́nà rǝ banì, acemǝnana kusǝ pas Yesu kǝ dapi kam andǝ alaggana male.

Agbani Pǝris andǝ amǝ Farisi tasǝ amǝ'yál Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli andǝ aɓea soje mala amǝ Roma, ɓǝa kyane atà Yahuda aban mǝnana Yesu nakam ngga. À kur rǝia nǝ agirbura, sǝ à bwal bǝsa arǝ aɓukan, andǝ apitǝla, pǝlǝa à puro à yì tusǝo a ɓabanì.
Sǝ Yesu ka angŋa dǝmba sǝlǝna gir mǝnana nǝ̀ kumi ka, pǝlǝa puro cam a ɓadǝmbia, sǝ ɗia ama,
À eare ama, <<Yesu ɓwa Nazarat.>> Banggia wia ama, <<Mǝ Nda.>>
Yahuda, yì ɓwa mǝnana mak Yesu ka, nda aban came ateà.
Lang Yesu banggia wia ama, <<Mǝ Nda>> ka, kara à nyar nǝ nzǝmia à sukki a nzali.
Pǝlǝa Yesu nyare ɗia ama,
À eare ama, <<Yesu Ɓwa Nazarat.>>
Yesu eare ama,

content.text: <<Ən nanà wun nǝma Mǝ Nda. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ mǝ nda wu alkiyitam ngga, wu ɗeki alaggana mem mǝnia ka ɓǝa o.>>

content: Mǝnia ka pa anggo ace mǝnana cau mana pur a kúni ka ɓǝ̀ lùmsǝo, mǝnana ama,

content.text: <<Dâ, aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana a pam ngga, ǝn turta kǝɓwa mwashat ɗang.>>

content: Shiman Bitǝrus kwetǝ nggeabyau, kwarǝna guro mala Pǝris Mǝgule nǝi, kasǝ kiri mǝlì kpat. (Lullǝ mǝno yì guro nda Malchus.)
Yesu banggi Bitǝrus ama,

content.text: <<Nyesǝ nggeabyau mo oasǝi a ndè! A kǝ sǝni kǝla pa mǝ nǝ nu kwap mala tanni mǝnana Tárrám pam ama ɓǝn nu ka re?>>

content: Yesu a ɓadǝm Annas Pǝris Mǝgule
Pǝlǝa asoje andǝ mǝ'sàrǝ̀ban malea, andǝ amǝ munagara mala amǝ Yahudi, bwal Yesu, sǝ à taka abui.
A tadǝmbe ka à umnǝ Yesu a ɓadǝm Annas, nkil Kayafas, yì Pǝris Mǝgule a mǝno yì pǝlǝa ka.
Kǝ Kayafas mǝno nda kwarkir aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi ama ndanǝ ɓoaro ɓǝ̀ ɓwa mwashat wú a kún aɓwana mala amǝ Yahudi ka.
Shiman Bitǝrus makgìr súrǝ̀ Yesu
Shiman Bitǝrus andǝ ɓe lagga mala Yesu wari a ban mǝnana à kútí nǝ Yesu kàm ngga. Mǝnia yì lagga ka Pǝris Mǝgule súrǝì pepè, nda sǝ à eari wi kutio aɓa ɓala mala Pǝris Mǝgule ka.
Bitǝrus ka ueo aban came a kunɓala nǝ nza. Sǝ mǝnia yì lagga mana pǝris mǝgule súrǝì ka, nyare yiu yi nacau nǝ muna-ɓwama mǝnana à tamsǝi ace yál kunɓala ka, pǝlǝa earî Bitǝrus ɓǝ̀ kutio.
Muna-ɓwame ɗì Bitǝrus ama, <<A nda gbal aɓalǝ amǝkpata ɓwa mǝno à bwali ka le?>> Bitǝrus eari wi ama, <<Awo, ǝn pa aɓalǝia ɗàng.>>
Ɗwal nda kam kǝ̀rkǝ́r, pǝlǝa amǝtúró palta andǝ amǝ munagara bwal bǝsa, à kǝ dandǝ rǝia. Sǝ Bitǝrus yiu, yi cam a bania a kun bǝsa.
Pǝris Mǝgule ɗiki Yesu
Pǝlǝa Pǝris Mǝgule tita ɗiki Yesu amur alaggana male andǝ kanigir male.
Yesu banggi wi ama,

content.text: <<Acau mem ngga ǝn nea bwāng a ɓadǝm ɓwapǝndǝa kat. Sǝ ko aya pwari ka mǝ ndaban kanigir arǝ ndakpapi andǝ Ndàmǝgule mala Ɓakuli, ban ramba mala amǝ Yahudi. Ən na kǝ cau aɓa sǝmbǝrǝa ɗang.
Sǝ ace man sǝ à kǝ ɗìkiam? Ɗì ka aɓwana mǝnana à ok cau mana ǝn na ka. Yia ka à súrǝ́nà rǝ cau mǝnana ǝn na ka.>>

content: Lang Yesu bangŋǝna anggo ka, ɓeɓwa aɓalǝ amǝ yál Ndàmǝgule, mǝnana came a banì, kwak Yesu a takiri, sǝ bang ama, <<Anggo sǝ a nǝ pǝlǝì Pǝris Mǝgule cau?>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu ear ama,

content.text: <<Ɓǝ̀ ǝn nacau mǝnana mǝɓane na ka, banggàm ɓá ɓwarke, sǝ ɓǝ̀ mǝsǝcau na ǝn na ka, mana nda tǝr koem a takiram?>>

content: Anggo, andǝa kǝ tà bu mǝnana à tàkà abu Yesu ka, sǝ Annas tasǝte a ban Kayafas, yì Pǝris Mǝgule.
Ɓaria andǝ tàruià tǝmcesúrǝ̀ Yesu mala Bitǝrus

Aɓa mǝno anggo ka, Shiman Bitǝrus nda àkǝ̀ bancame a kun bǝsa, aban dandǝ rǝì. Sǝ aɓwana a banì ɗì ama, <<We ka, a pa aɓalǝ alaggana mala ɓwa mǝno re?>> Pǝlǝa yì ka, tǝmce, na ama, <<Awo, ǝn pa aɓalǝia ɗàng.>>
Sǝ ɓeɓwa mwashat aɓalǝ aguro mala Pǝris Mǝgule, ɓǝla mala ɓwa mǝnana Bitǝrus kasǝ kiri ka, nacau ama, <<Ən sǝno mǝni atà Yesu akanó a ɓaban re?>>
Bitǝrus nyare tǝmce, ama, <<Awo mǝ nda ɗang.>> Anggo ka, kara nggu ɓua.
A warinǝ Yesu a ɓadǝm Bilatus

Nǝ dǝmbari ɗiɗyal ka à pusǝ Yesu a ɓala mala Kayafas, à um nǝi a banmǝgule mala Nggwamna, ɓwa Roma. Sǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi, mǝnana à tsǝki Yesu cau atè ka, à ɓinǝ kutio aɓa palta mala Nggwamna, acemǝnana ɓǝà kútí ka, à nǝ̀ pǝndǝki ɓamuria, mǝnana nǝ̀ tsǝa à pà nǝ̀ kùmô à nǝ̀ li girlina Lamsan Yàlîmurû raka.
Ace mǝno ka, Bilatus pur a bania, sǝ ɗia ama, <<Ya cau na wu yiu nǝi amur mǝnia yì ɓwa ka le?>>
Pǝlǝa à eare ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ ɓwa mǝnia ka, mǝ'ɓealɓikea na raka, ɓǝ́ pa sǝm nǝ̀ yiu nǝi a bano ɗàng.>>
Bilatus pǝlǝa banggia wia ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ nda anggo ka, wu um nǝi, wu kya ɓashi wi nǝ nggurcau ma'wun la.>> Pǝlǝa amǝ Yahudi eare ama, <<Sǝm pà nǝ́ rǝcandǝa mala kasǝ ɓashi-lú amur kǝɓwa ɗàng.>>
Mǝnia ka lùmsǝ cau mǝnana Yesu bang amur ulang lú mǝnana nǝ̀ wu ka.
Pǝlǝa Bilatus nyare aɓa palta male sǝ túrban ɓǝà kútí nǝ Yesu a baní. Ɗì Yesu ama, <<A nda murǝm mala amǝ Yahudi le?>>
Yesu eari wi ama,

content.text: <<Mǝnia yì ɗiban ngga, a twali a mala ɓamuro le ko aɓea ɓwana na à no cau a muram ngga?>>

content: Bilatus ne wi ama, <<Mim ngga mǝ nda ɓwa Yahudi le? Aɓwana mô andǝ agbani pǝris ma'wun na à yiu nǝ we a ɓashi a banam ngga. Mana ɗe a pa?>>
Yesu eare ama,

content.text: <<Domurǝm mem ngga mala ɓanza mǝnia na ɗang. Ɓǝ̀ pǝlǝ ama mala ɓanza man na ka, ɓǝ́ amǝkpatam nǝ̀ munǝo acem, à pà nǝ̀ eari aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi ɓǝà bwalam ɗang. Awo, domurǝm mem ngga mala ɓanza man na ɗang.>>

content: Bilatus pǝlǝa ne Yesu ama, <<Ashe a nda murǝm!>> Yesu eari wi ama,

content.text: <<A bang ama mǝ nda murǝm. Ace kǝ mani sǝ à ɓǝ̀lám, sǝ yiu mem a ɓanza ka nda ace na mǝsǝcau, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana kat kǝ camata mǝsǝcau ka, kǝ kwakikiri kǝ ok giem.>>

content: Pǝlǝa Bilatus ɗì ama, <<Mana nda mǝsǝcau?>> Bilatus pà Yesu ɓǝà wal-luí (Matiu 27:15-31; Markus 15:6-20; Luka 23:13-25) Bilatus nyare puro a ban amǝ Yahudi sǝ banggia wia ama, <<Mim ngga ǝn kumi nǝ ɓekǝ cauɓikea ɗang!

Sǝ wun amǝ Yahudi ka, ko aya pǝlǝa sǝ ɓǝ̀ yi karǝ nǝ Lamsan Yàlîmurû ka, pàk ka wu kǝ earce ama ɓǝn panzǝa wun ɓwa mwashat atà aɓwana mǝnana à kùria a ndàkurban ngga. Ado ka, wu earce ɓǝn panzǝa wun mǝnia yì <Murǝm mala amǝ Yahudi> ka le?>>
Sǝ à nyesǝi wi nǝ loasǝban ama, <<Awo, ɓwa mǝnia na à nǝ̀ panzǝa sǝmi ka ɗàng! Panzǝa sǝm Barabbas!>> (Barabbas ka à bwali acemǝnana yì ka, mǝ'mgbicau na.)

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 26:30,36; Mar 14:26,32; Luk 22:39; 2Sam 15:23.
